subject: Marketplace listing: badge usage + support-window discrepancy
messages:
From: AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Action required: listing badge & support-window for 'Redwood Inference' (Listing ID: RI-aws-3421)

Hi Kimberly,

During our routine QA pass we identified two issues on the public listing for Redwood Inference (ID RI-aws-3421):

1) Badge usage: The page displays a custom badge that references "Redwood Verified" and a performance claim that isn't aligned with Marketplace badge policy. Our guidelines (attached) require standardized badging language and pre-approval for any performance claims.

2) Support hours: The listing shows a support window of "9am–5pm PT" but the listing tier requires 24x7 customer support or a documented escalation path for production workloads.

Please remediate these items within 72 hours or submit a remediation plan and timeline. If you need an extension, request one with the specific changes and a target date.

Attachment: badge-guidelines_v2.pdf

If you have questions, loop in your legal/marketing contacts for wording and your CS/ops contacts for support commitments.

Thanks,
AWS Marketplace Ops
for the Marketplace Listing Team

Subject: Re: Action required: listing badge & support window for 'Redwood Inference' (Listing ID: RI-aws-3421)

Hi —

Thanks for the heads up and the attachment. We're pulling the page live edits now and aligning on a response. Internal owners: Marissa (marketing) and Ben (sales) are on this thread.

Immediate actions from our side:
- Temporarily remove the custom "Redwood Verified" badge and replace with the standard "Partner" badge pending approved wording.
- Update support window copy to call out: "24x7 escalation available via our dedicated marketplace channel; standard business-hours support for onboarding/training."
- Opened internal ticket (MP-1987) to track the copy change and engineering deploy.

Ben — can you confirm we can offer the escalation channel 24x7 at the L2 level (we may route L3 to on-call engineers during off-hours)? I attached our current coverage CSV for reference.

Kimberly Park

Redwood Inference

Kimberly / Ben —

Thanks — quick guidance from marketing/legal perspective:
- Remove any unapproved performance phrasing ("Verified", numerical latency claims) — Marketplace requires neutral wording. Suggested line: "Performance profiles available; see documentation for benchmark details."
- For the badge, submit a badge request through partner portal (link below). Until approved, use the standard Partner badge asset.

On support:
- We can commit to 24x7 first-line escalation (L1/L2 triage) via our marketplace support queue; L3 will be on-call by rotation and may have a longer SLA for non-critical tickets.
- Ops (Jonas) please add a short-runbook that maps severity -> on-call contact and target ack times. We'll attach the runbook to the listing.

I started a short PRD to capture the copy + runbook and linked the Jira: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/MP-1987

Proposed customer-facing phrasing (draft):
"Support: 24x7 escalation available via Redwood Inference Marketplace support channel. Production-impact incidents will be triaged immediately; engineering escalation available on a rota."

If AWS needs a stricter 24x7 operational SLA (e.g., 1-hour ack for Sev1), we'll need to elevate to revenue ops to confirm.

—Marissa
